question_text: In a certain transformer there are 360 turns in the primary coil and 30 turns in the secondary coil. Which of the following voltage changes can be achieved by this transformer?

options.option_text: 240 V AC voltage to 12 V DC voltage.
240 V AC voltage to 20 V AC voltage.
240 V DC voltage to 20 V AC voltage.
240 V AC voltage to 2880 V DC voltage.
240 V DC voltage to 2880 V DC voltage.
